paragraphs: The G400d uses the OM656 - a 2.9-litre inline-six diesel. It was fitted from 2018 across the W463a generation of the G-Class. This engine is a member of a modern family of Mercedes diesel engines also found in the S-Class and GLS. The OM656 is a reliable and powerful unit, but like all modern diesels, it benefits from regular servicing and the occasional component replacement. A full rebuild can address wear items such as timing chains, injector seals, and gaskets, restoring your engine to near-new condition.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace M256 engines for every G400D on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the G400D from 2023 to present. The M256 features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older M276 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every M256 rebuild.
